description: Source code implementing a linked list for managing receipt messages, including functions to add, process, and clear receipt nodes, with external dependencies on JSON parsing and logging.

methods.name: receipt_list_add
methods.description: Adds a new receipt node with specified ID, type, and callback to the linked list.

methods.name: receipt_list_process
methods.description: Processes a receipt with given ID, parses the result, invokes callback, and removes the node from the list.

methods.name: receipt_list_clear
methods.description: Clears all receipt nodes from the list, freeing memory.
